name: Matched-budget A-vs-C primary pilot
purpose: Preregister and run the matched-budget solve@B test for the clean PRIMARY causal mechanism: same verified CSP symbolic-CBJ search trace, same tokenizer counter, A_cache retained-prefix billing versus C_incontext accumulated-context billing. This pilot tests whether the Item117 cost advantage converts into solve@budget advantage at B* on sudoku and futoshiki. External SOTA baselines are not run because faithful Qwen3-4B fp32 implementations are not integrated, and no curve is fabricated.

provenance.spec: user SPEC — Matched-Budget Head-to-Head, Cache-Truncation Search vs SOTA Search (PREREGISTERED, v0)

code_added_used.change: Adds preregistration and primary-csp matched-budget curve harness using verified CSP traces and shared A/C token accounting.

commands.purpose: Record fixed HB-1/HB-2/HB-3 kills before reading matched-budget curves.
Run pilot matched-budget A-vs-C curves on native symbolic-CBJ CSP traces.

headline.sudoku: B*=28070 tokens from C mid-band rule; A solve=1.0, C solve=0.5, gap=0.5 on n=2 symbolic-CBJ traces.
headline.futoshiki: B*=3206226 tokens from C mid-band rule; A solve=1.0, C solve=0.5, gap=0.5 on n=2 symbolic-CBJ traces.
headline.shape: A solve@B dominates C over all grid budgets and the mid-budget band for both tasks in this pilot.
headline.single_next_move: Treat this as a positive causal pilot that cost can convert to solve@budget, then scale n/background and add faithful external baselines before any SOTA claim.

gate_outcomes.number: A_ge_C over all grid budgets and mid-band for sudoku/futoshiki symbolic-CBJ.
LFS, ReST-MCTS*, Beyond-the-Frontier, To-Backtrack-or-Not not run; faithful local implementations unavailable.

decision.next_step_routing: Scale the primary pilot to larger n in background and only then decide whether to promote the solve@budget claim. Keep external SOTA positioning as not-run until faithful implementations are integrated.

honesty.does_not_establish: This item does not establish full SOTA solve@budget competitiveness or a large-n final curve. It is a primary causal pilot on n=2 per task.
honesty.external_limit: External baselines were not run; they remain explicitly not-run rather than approximated.
honesty.policy_limit: The formal run uses native symbolic-CBJ on sudoku/futoshiki. Chronological and graph_color C1 matched-budget live runs are not completed in this item.
honesty.scaling_note: A broader n run was attempted but full futoshiki traces with growing-context tokenization were too slow for immediate closeout; it should be launched separately with source selection or optimized accounting.
